notes.title: Two Dollars for Toon Brawlers
notes.notes:
This is the cheapest the game's been and new content and bug fixes have been released since launch. Easier to understand, better controller support, heavier jumping and an invincibility and hardcore mode introduced. Now's the best time (so far) to buy Floogen! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32026872/3af0cc2424d6465ee31407ea85aed597e98a75dd.jpg[/img]

SO BUY IT NOW.

notes.title: horizontal patch
notes.notes: made the jump heavier without accounting for how crud that made the horizontal air movement. fixed that. also fixed the mountain climb in level 2 to be less buggy.

notes.title: quick fix
notes.notes: world 2 seed now destroyable, changed iananimator to 'treehut presents' on the title screen. moved a star in level 4 to a more sensible location. adjusted some jumps to make them more reasonable.

notes.title: the heavy patch
notes.notes:
the cast of floogen gained weight. jumping is more heavy to hopefully get rid of the 'floaty' feel. 

enemies wont respawn now unless you break the checkpoints, initiating 'hardcore mode'.
hopefully this also makes the game a little more fair.

notes.title: patch so and so
notes.notes: Fishing works again, Napolians level can be completed in world 2, and the tentacles in the final boss give you some time before they bring the pain.

notes.title: less clunky combat
notes.notes:
axe does damage INSTANTLY instead of a short delay. this should ease some of the issues i've heard with the combat and give it a more responsive 'game feel'

also added a checkpoint at the final boss, updated the BG for level 2 and some lighting bugs

notes.title: patch 7?
notes.notes:
The raven learned to not drop our soldiers into the swamp but still didn't quite hit the mark. That raven was let go later that day and has been replaced by an identical raven. 

The pipes in hell splurt out danger less often making it more tolerable. 

The platforms in hell are easier to jump upon and no longer have you fall through them occasionally.

notes.title: nevermore
notes.notes: the raven thought it was funny to drop our warriors into the swamp. we have corrected the birds behavior...

notes.title: patch 4
notes.notes:
The evil Floogen had put an invisible barrier on the Tower. I sent in some mages to destroy it. You're free to eradiate the Floogen from the forest now. 

Additionally, the swamp now dyes you purple as a nice visual flair.

notes.title: patch 3 [Seb Mode]
notes.notes:
Ring the bell after five or more deaths on a level and press the Blue Button to enable Seb Mode. In Seb Mode, you won't take damage. You will still die from falls but this may be a nice option for anyone struggling.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5K2y4mw.png[/img]

notes.title: Aerial Axe Move!
notes.notes:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1298759425

Over the weekend I've been figuring how to make the game control better, and more importantly, be fun.

Jumping around can get stale after a while. Here's a new move! If you roll, then atack, you swing your axe into the ground and this thrusts you into the air where you deal damage to everything you come in contact with! It will eat up all your stamina so don't expect to be able to spam this move all the way through the level. It's also sporadic and hard to control, so doing this in platform heavy areas isn't always a good idea, but you will look awesome if you pull it off. 

I've also made tweaks to the difficulty. Before, the puddles of poison would instantly kill you, now, they deal massive damage and allow you to continue, ala Mario lava. 

Work continues, thanks for reading.
